name: Bjørn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjørn Halvorsen's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a lifelong fascination with complex systems and logistical challenges. Growing up in Bergen, he initially pursued a career in maritime logistics, orchestrating cargo movements across the North Sea. However, the thrill of precision timing and the high-stakes environment drew him to the roaring engines and pit-stop precision of racing. He transitioned into motorsport a decade ago, starting with a smaller rally team before joining Walkenhorst Motorsport three years ago.

As Logistics Coordinator, Bjørn is responsible for the seamless flow of equipment, personnel, and supplies to race events worldwide. He thrives on meticulous planning, proactive problem-solving, and the unwavering pursuit of efficiency. Bjørn is known for his demanding nature; he has high expectations of his team and himself, always pushing for optimal performance. His ability to see the big picture, anticipate potential bottlenecks, and implement contingency plans has proven invaluable to Walkenhorst's success.

 Bjørn's distinctive approach lies in his blend of maritime logistics principles and motorsport's dynamic demands. He meticulously tracks every component, analyzes historical data to predict future needs, and maintains a rigorous communication network to keep everyone informed and prepared.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Bjørn is a tall, lean man with a focused gaze and a perpetually furrowed brow.
